definitions.atr_entry: ATR(14) at the SIGNAL bar t (= entry_idx-1); this is the ATR that set stop_price = close - 1.5*ATR
definitions.atr_exit: ATR(14) at the exit bar index
definitions.fwdH: ATR(14) at bar t+H divided by ATR(14) at bar t, regardless of whether the trade was still open
definitions.survivor@H: fwdH restricted to trades with bars_held >= H
definitions.contraction: ATR(14)/ATR(50) at the signal bar (exogenous, known at entry)
